replacements.De pares a triples: instrucción visual: From pairs to triples: visual instruction tuning
replacements.Los pares imagen-texto enseñan represent: Image–text pairs teach representations. Instruction triples teach behavior. They are different stages and cannot replace each other.
replacements.acercar pares correctos · alejar pares i: bring correct pairs closer · push incorrect pairs apart
replacements.Aprende a reconocer — qué cosas hablan d: Learns to recognize — which things refer to the same content
replacements.minimizar error en la respuesta esperada: minimize error on the expected response
replacements.Aprende a responder — cómo actuar ante u: Learns to respond — how to act on a specific instruction
replacements.El par aprende a reconocer. El triple ap: The pair learns to recognize. The triple learns to respond. A model trained only on pairs knows which things are similar, but it does not know how to follow instructions. A model trained only on triples does not have sufficiently robust base representations to generalize beyond the instructions seen during fine-tuning.
replacements.cualquier imagen del dataset base: any image from the base dataset
replacements.la imagen se describe en texto para pasa: the image is described in text so it can be passed to the generator model
replacements.instrucción plausible y respuesta espera: a plausible instruction and expected response for the image
replacements.miles de triples (imagen, instrucción, r: thousands of triples (image, instruction, response) without human-annotation cost
replacements.capaz de seguir instrucciones visuales c: capable of following visual instructions with notable quality
replacements.LLaVA (2023) demostró que la generación: LLaVA (2023) showed that synthetic generation with GPT-4 produces models capable of following visual instructions with notable quality relative to the cost of generating the data. The approach has become common practice in projects without the budget for large-scale human annotation.
replacements.Si el modelo que genera los datos tiene: If the model generating the data has blind spots, the model trained on them inherits those blind spots. The quality of the result is bounded by the quality of the generator. The biases are not in the visual data themselves but in the instructions and responses that GPT-4 constructs from them.
